appDesc.message: Highlights Angular components when change detection runs - like React DevTools

jevHint.message: Jev (TypeSafe AI) automatically detects excessive re-rendering. While enabled, only the re-render count, change detection strategy, app type (Zone.js or Zoneless), and trigger type (e.g. mousemove, timer) are sent to the Jev API (no component names or page content). Your API key is stored locally on this device only.

jevThresholdLabel.message: Diagnose at N re-renders in 2 sec

jevCauseParentPropagation.message: Re-rendered along with its parent component

jevCauseEventHandlerRecreation.message: Functions or objects are recreated on every render

jevCauseFrequentEvent.message: A high-frequency event (mousemove, scroll, etc.) triggers change detection

jevCauseTimerPolling.message: A timer, animation frame, or polling triggers change detection

jevFixRunOutsideAngular.message: Run it outside the Angular zone (runOutsideAngular)

jevFixThrottle.message: Debounce or throttle the event / timer

jevFixNoAction.message: No action needed if the updates are expected
